summary: Approvers can always see exactly what they approve, and greyed-out buttons explain themselves.

new.title: Approval requests list what they authorise
new.text: Requests raised from a refused Review & Save now list the staged changes in plain words. The manual Raise a request form requires the same list, pre-filled where possible.

new.title: Copying settings between tenants is documented
new.text: The Naming conventions card now shows the command that copies a setting to another tenant. It is a dry run unless you ask it to apply.

fixes.title: Greyed-out buttons say why
fixes.text: Commit selected now shows on the button itself why it is off, instead of in a paragraph above the table.

fixes.title: "Already authorised" needs nothing from you
fixes.text: The panel of changes your managed tenants will receive now says they are done and travel on the next publish. You only act to cancel a mistake.
